headline: Colonials Seize Crumbling Post as Fighting Rages Across Northern Hexes
war_summary: Colonials captured Crumbling Post in Callahan's Passage within the past two hours, breaching the northern bastion amidst heavy sustained fire and over a thousand combined casualties in the latest watch. Weathered Expanse remains an active maelstrom, recording four structural actions over the past two hours around Crow's Nest and Frostmarch, leaving one strategic position derelict in no-man's-land. In Mooring County, intense grinding combat persists with over eight hundred casualties logged in two hours, though front lines have stabilized following earlier furious contests at Gravekeeper's Holdfast and Wiccwalk. Palantine Berm's contested sector has cooled over the latest two-hour interval following sharp earlier exchanges at Leiri Hermanni and The Droll. Secondary skirmishing along the Nevish Line and Stlican Shelf continues at a reduced tempo with no fresh territorial shifts, while the southern hexes and interior supply corridors remain entirely quiet.
